4 days | Kigali and Volcanoes gorillas

Package overview

Kigali, a night beside Volcanoes National Park, one gorilla trek, and a simple return. The permit is the largest cost and is quoted on its own.

A short, well-paced gorilla trek. Highlights: Volcanoes National Park, One gorilla hour, Time in Kigali that is not rushed.

Route Kigali → Volcanoes National Park → Kigali

The Rwanda gorilla permit is extra. The park fee is currently about USD 1,500 per person. Permits are often non-refundable once issued.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Kigali

Arrival. The Kigali Genocide Memorial can be included as a quiet, guided visit. It is optional, and it is not a photo stop.

Accommodation: Kigali

02Day 2 | Kigali to Volcanoes

About two and a half hours to Musanze. A community walk in the afternoon if you want one.

Accommodation: Volcanoes

03Day 3 | Gorilla trek

Park briefing, then the trek. One hour with the family once the rangers reach them. Overnight near the park.

Accommodation: Volcanoes

04Day 4 | Back to Kigali

Morning return for departure, with time for a shower and lunch if your flight is later.

Accommodation: Departure

Where you sleep

Budget is a permanent tent or a simple lodge. Mid-range is an en-suite lodge or tented camp. Luxury is a smaller camp and, where it helps, a flight between parks. The camp names are written on your quote.

What's included

  • Accommodation on the plan we send you
  • Meals noted in the day-by-day itinerary
  • A private 4x4 with a pop-up roof and an English-speaking guide
  • Park and conservancy fees for the places on the itinerary
  • Arrival and departure transfers in the city where the trip starts
  • Bottled drinking water in the vehicle

What's excluded

  • International flights
  • Visas, vaccinations and travel insurance
  • Gorilla and chimpanzee permits, unless your quote includes them
  • Tips, laundry, premium drinks and personal purchases
  • Balloon flights, extra activities and community visits
